title: Unique Syrian Wrap
description: A delicious and healthy wrap filled with unique flavors and crunchy textures, inspired by Syrian cuisine.
instructions: Cook the oatmeal according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped unique and velvety ingredients and cook until lightly browned.
Warm the wrap in the same pan or in the microwave.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the cooked oatmeal on the wrap, followed by the unique and velvety mixture.
Add any desired additional toppings, such as chopped herbs or sliced vegetables.
